gizmo.title: Hero
gizmo.description: Onyonyo, GIF ma ọ bụ vidiyo buru ibu nwere isiokwu na ederede n'elu ya, etinyere ebe ọ bụla na peeji.

configure.title: Onyonyo ma ọ bụ vidiyo
configure.description: Faịlụ JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4 ma ọ bụ WebM.

configure.title: Ederede nnọchi
configure.description: Kọwaa onyonyo ahụ. Hapụ ya efu ma ọ bụrụ naanị ihe ịchọ mma.

configure.title: Isiokwu
configure.description: Isiokwu e gosiri n'elu mgbasa ozi ahụ. Hapụ ya efu maka ọ dịghị.

configure.title: Ederede
configure.description: Ederede e gosiri n'okpuru isiokwu, n'elu mgbasa ozi ahụ.

configure.title: Obosara zuru ezu
configure.description: Gbatịa site n'otu nsọtụ ruo na nke ọzọ kama ịnọ n'ime kọlụm ọdịnaya.

configure.title: Nhazi okpokolo
configure.description: Otu foto ahụ si anọ na nha ihuenyo ọ bụla

advanced.title: Ịchapụ
advanced.description: Agba etinyere n'elu mgbasa ozi ahụ. Mgbe e nwere isiokwu ma ọ bụ ederede, a na-enwe otu mgbe niile, ka ederede ahụ nwee ike ịgụ.

advanced.title: Ebe nlebara anya n'obosara
advanced.description: Akụkụ onyonyo na-anọgide na-ahụ anya mgbe a bechapụrụ ya, site na 0 (aka ekpe) ruo 100 (aka nri).

advanced.title: Ebe nlebara anya n'ogologo
advanced.description: Akụkụ onyonyo na-anọgide na-ahụ anya mgbe a bechapụrụ ya, site na 0 (elu) ruo 100 (ala).
